description: amFX reproduction (24JAN23 p2): WMR Fix autocorrelation strategy on AUDUSD. If 10am-11am NY return > +0.4%, go long 10am-11am next day. Cumulative P&L shows step-function shape with most alpha from COVID 2020 extreme fix flows. 62% win rate on ~94 occurrences. Source: amFX 24JAN23 newsletter (Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets).
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: WMR FIX AUTOCORRELATION — AUDUSD (24JAN23 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Tests whether large WMR fix flows persist to the next day.
# Strategy: if 10am-11am NY return > +0.4%, go long 10am-11am next day.
# Original chart: cumulative P&L 2010-2022, step-function shape.
# Most alpha came from COVID 2020 extreme multi-day fix flows.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Time of day in NY timezone (minutes from midnight)
bar_idx = index()
bar_tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='America/New_York')(bar_idx)

# 60-minute return at each bar (= 10am-11am window return at the 11am bar)
ret_60 = roc(period=60)(close)

# Filter to 11am ET bars only (660 = 11 * 60)
fix_ret = ret_60 if (bar_tod == 660.0) else 0.0 / 0.0

# Forward-fill: carry last 11am return until next 11am
fix_ret_ff = ffill(fix_ret)

# At 11am: 1 bar ago still has yesterday's ffilled value
prev_fix = fix_ret_ff >> 1

# Strategy return: today's fix return when yesterday exceeded +0.4%
strat_ret = ret_60 if (bar_tod == 660.0 and prev_fix > 0.004) else 0.0

# Cumulative P&L (percentage)
cum_pnl = cumulative()(strat_ret) * 100.0

# Filter to 11am bars for plotting (avoid millions of flat points)
cum_pnl_plot = cum_pnl if (bar_tod == 660.0) else 0.0 / 0.0

# =============================================================================
# CHART: Cumulative P&L
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='AUDUSD WMR Fix Autocorrelation: +0.4% at 10-11am Predicts Next Day',
    category='WMR Fix Strategy',
    y_axis_label='Cumulative Return (%)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Cum P&L', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Breakeven', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_idx, cum_pnl_plot)
